SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    '{{ $json.dry_run ? "true" : "false" }}'::boolean AS dry_run,
    '{{ $json.force ? "true" : "false" }}'::boolean AS force_dispatch,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF('{{ $json.limit || "" }}', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
        THEN LEAST(GREATEST(NULLIF('{{ $json.limit || "" }}', '')::integer, 1), 100)
      ELSE LEAST(GREATEST(get_system_config_int('campaign.outbound.dispatch-batch-size', 100), 1), 100)
    END AS batch_limit,
    NULLIF('{{ $json.brand || "" }}', '') AS brand,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $json.source || "" }}', ''), 'schedule') AS source
), gate AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    get_system_config_bool('campaign.outbound.dispatch-enabled', false) AS dispatch_enabled
  FROM params p
), pending AS (
  SELECT
    l.id AS lead_id,
    l.quicklink_id,
    l.marca::text AS marca,
    l.nombre_cliente,
    l.telefono_1,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(l)->>'telefono_agente', ''), l.telefono_1) AS telefono_agente,
    l.modelo,
    l.sincronizado_at,
    l.created_at
  FROM leads_quicklink l
  CROSS JOIN gate g
  WHERE (g.dry_run OR g.force_dispatch OR g.dispatch_enabled)
    AND l.estado_agente = 'PENDIENTE'
    AND l.conversacion_id IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(l)->>'telefono_agente', ''), l.telefono_1), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND length(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(l)->>'telefono_agente', ''), l.telefono_1), '\D', '', 'g')) BETWEEN 9 AND 15
    AND (g.brand IS NULL OR l.marca::text = g.brand)
  ORDER BY l.sincronizado_at ASC, l.created_at ASC
  LIMIT (SELECT batch_limit FROM gate)
)
SELECT
  g.dry_run,
  g.force_dispatch,
  g.dispatch_enabled,
  g.batch_limit,
  g.brand,
  g.source,
  COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.sincronizado_at ASC, p.created_at ASC) FILTER (WHERE p.lead_id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS leads,
  COUNT(p.lead_id)::integer AS lead_count
FROM gate g
LEFT JOIN pending p ON true
GROUP BY g.dry_run, g.force_dispatch, g.dispatch_enabled, g.batch_limit, g.brand, g.source;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    '{{ $json.dry_run ? "true" : "false" }}'::boolean AS dry_run,
    '{{ $json.force_dispatch ? "true" : "false" }}'::boolean AS force_dispatch,
    '{{ $json.dispatch_enabled ? "true" : "false" }}'::boolean AS dispatch_enabled,
    {{ Number($json.batch_limit || 0) }}::integer AS batch_limit,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.brand || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS brand,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ String($json.source || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''), 'schedule') AS source,
    $leads${{ JSON.stringify($json.leads || []) }}$leads$::jsonb AS leads,
    $dispatch_leads${{ JSON.stringify(($json.leads || []).map(lead => ({
      id: lead.lead_id,
      quicklink_id: lead.quicklink_id,
      marca: lead.marca,
      phone: lead.telefono_agente || lead.telefono_1 || ''
    }))) }}$dispatch_leads$::jsonb AS dispatch_leads,
    (
      (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Guayaquil')::integer * 60)
      + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Guayaquil')::integer
    ) BETWEEN 570 AND 960 AS inside_send_window
), opened AS (
  SELECT o.*
  FROM src s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL open_outbound_dispatch_batch(
    'cris05:' || '{{ $execution.id }}',
    s.source,
    s.dispatch_leads
  ) o
  WHERE NOT s.dry_run
    AND (s.dispatch_enabled OR s.force_dispatch)
    AND s.inside_send_window
    AND jsonb_array_length(s.dispatch_leads) > 0
)
SELECT
  s.dry_run,
  s.force_dispatch,
  s.dispatch_enabled,
  s.batch_limit,
  s.brand,
  s.source,
  s.leads,
  jsonb_array_length(s.leads)::integer AS lead_count,
  s.inside_send_window,
  o.batch_id,
  o.batch_key,
  o.status_token,
  COALESCE(o.dispatches, '[]'::jsonb) AS dispatches
FROM src s
LEFT JOIN opened o ON true;
